statement: Zmey has never received a National Security Letter, gag order, or any other legal demand that would prohibit us from disclosing its existence.
Zmey has never been compelled to backdoor, weaken, or add surveillance capability to its encryption.
Zmey has never been compelled to hand over private keys or user message content — and has no technical ability to do so regardless, by design.
Zmey has never turned over user data to a government agency, under compulsion or voluntarily, beyond what Swiss law requires for legitimate account administration.
